body.p: In most cases, the conversion creates an equivalent schema, but there are some limitations:

ul.li: Restrictions/facets are not taken into consideration when converting (fractionDigits, pattern, totalDigits, whiteSpace, minInclusive, maxInclusive, and the restrictions for length, except enumeration). However, extensions and indicators are properly converted (minOccurs, maxOccurs, group, sequence, choice).
The documentation element is not converted into description.
The substitutionGroup attribute for an element that has no declared type becomes a reference to the element that can substitute it.
The block attribute is not taken into consideration during the conversion.
